verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a library of markdown skills and plugin bootstraps that run inside coding-agent harnesses, not a hosted service that emits events. Subscribing to its events through registrable outbound HTTP webhooks is outside this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships webhooks; its session-start hook is harness context injection, not an outbound HTTP callback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
